# #439 Halvårssummering

**Feed**: market-makers  
**Published**: 2026-07-02  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This half-year retrospective episode has the hosts reviewing a volatile H1 2026 that they describe as feeling like four separate market cycles crammed into six months: a small-cap crash, a silver-mining mania and bust, the Hormuz/Iran conflict shock, and a semiconductor/AI melt-up. Both hosts admit to weak or barely positive personal returns versus strong large-cap and index performance (Investor +20%, OMXS30 +10% vs. First North -11%), and use the episode to dissect portfolio mistakes around sizing, correlated 'fake diversification', chasing value into falling knives versus riding momentum, and the psychological toll of drawdowns, while also naming current holdings and lessons heading into H2.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 MTRS — Munters | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fabian calls Munters Sweden's purest large-cap AI infrastructure case at a low valuation, but it's down 15% since April 14 while an AI infra ETF is up 60%, hurt by component-shortage guidance.

#### Reasoning

Despite underperforming the broader AI infrastructure rally after management flagged component shortages pressuring Q2 margins, Fabian believes the investment case remains intact. He expects margins to improve meaningfully in H2 2026 and profit to be substantially higher in 2027, with potential to beat analyst estimates, even though near-term share price action has been painful.

#### Sell Triggers

- if H2 margins fail to improve as expected
- if component shortages persist beyond Q2
- if 2027 earnings fail to beat estimates

> *"Caset för mig har hela tiden varit att marginalen ska börja bli betydligt bättre i H2. Och sen så 2027 så kommer man kunna se att vinsten är ordentligt mycket högre."*

---

### 🟠 NELLY — Nelly | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Nelly has fallen ~40% twice this year on weak Q4/Q1 reports; strong Swedish apparel retail data and falling short interest raise hopes for a decent Q2, though Fabian hasn't taken a position.

#### Reasoning

Nelly stock is heavily beaten down after two ~40% drops following weak reports. Fabian notes Swedish clothing retail statistics have been strong and short interest in Nelly has fallen sharply ahead of the print, suggesting positioning for a less-bad Q2. He flags that costs have risen substantially since a strong prior-year Q2 comp, raising the bar for margin improvement, and says he hasn't taken a speculative position despite viewing the sector as strong.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q2 growth is insufficient to offset the higher cost base versus a strong prior-year comp
- if e-commerce apparel demand trend reverses

> *"Jag tycker ändå att sektorn ser stark ut och det skulle inte förvåna mig om den lägger upp mycket på rapporten."*

---

### 🟠 RDDT — Reddit | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Magnus holds Reddit; the stock has been flat as the market questions whether its monetization trajectory is sustainable, but a strong next report could trigger a re-rating.

#### Reasoning

Magnus believes the market is currently skeptical about the durability of Reddit's monetization growth, keeping the stock range-bound. He thinks a strong upcoming quarterly report could remove that overhang and lead to a re-rating higher, framing non-AI US tech names like Reddit, SAS, Spotify and Klarna as an interesting area broadly.

#### Sell Triggers

- if next quarterly report shows monetization growth disappointing

> *"Tänker att den här monetiseringsresan de är på är nog inte uthållig. Så kommer nästa kvartalsrapport in bra så kanske det blir lite tuta att köra där."*

---

### ⛔ TIGR — UP Fintech (Tiger Brokers) | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Magnus held small positions in Tiger Brokers/UP Fintech (the 'Asian Avanza'); Chinese state confiscation of assets caused a severe decline, reinforcing his rule to avoid Chinese equities on political risk.

#### Reasoning

Magnus had previously said he wouldn't own Chinese stocks due to elevated political risk, but bought Tiger Brokers/UP Fintech anyway because it looked cheap. The Chinese state then confiscated assets, causing a large decline. He now treats this as confirmation that geopolitical risk in China (and similarly exposed jurisdictions) should not be underestimated, and prefers stocks in stable democracies going forward.

> *"Jag har ju sagt innan att jag inte ska äga kinesiska aktier för det är för stor politisk risk. Men ändå så gör man det när det ser för billigt ut."*

---

### 🟢 ACAST — Acast | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Niklas holds Acast as a core, higher-conviction position and would buy more on a 10% dip.

#### Reasoning

Niklas describes Acast as a name he knows well and wants to own more of, saying he would add on a 10% decline and can stay calm even if it underperforms, in contrast to lower-conviction names like Nelly where he trimmed to a small position after losing confidence.

> *"Jag vet ju att om det går ner 10% i A-Cost så vill jag äga mer."*

---

### 🟢 PLEJD — Plejd | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Niklas holds Plejd as a core, higher-conviction position and would buy more on a 10% dip.

#### Reasoning

Same conviction-driven approach as Acast: Niklas says he would add to Plejd on a 10% pullback because it's a business he understands well and is comfortable holding through volatility, part of his broader shift toward fewer, higher-conviction core positions after H1's turbulence.

> *"Om det går ner 10% i ett Played så vill jag äga mer."*

---
